description: Always applicable. The response uses the user's established conversation language across text, voice, and tool-backed answers. A switch is correct only after an explicit request or a complete utterance that clearly establishes another language. Names, accents, hotel or place names, isolated foreign words, and tool-output language must not trigger a switch. Tool evidence is translated and summarized into the established language.

Always applicable. Assess only whether the response is linguistically clear, natural, concise, and understandable in the established language. Do not score factual provenance, citations, tool traces, or whether a tool call is visible; those concerns belong to other evaluators.
